oxc/bad-char-at-comparison.because: r2-d49-51: oxc with oxlint, unicorn without. Both report String(value).charAt(0) === 'ab'; unicorn's reports only a receiver it can prove a string, oxc's any receiver (measured, oxlint 1.87, eslint-plugin-unicorn 77.0.0)

oxc/bad-comparison-sequence.because: #55: run both. Both report a < b < c (measured, oxlint 1.87, eslint-plugin-unicorn 77.0.0)

oxc/double-comparisons.because: #55: run both. Both report x === y || x < y; unicorn's is silent on x == y || x < y (measured, oxlint 1.87, eslint-plugin-unicorn 77.0.0)

oxc/erasing-op.because: r2-d49-51: oxc with oxlint, unicorn without. Both report x * 0 (measured, oxlint 1.87, eslint-plugin-unicorn 77.0.0)

oxc/misrefactored-assign-op.because: r2-d49-51: oxc with oxlint, unicorn without. Both report total += total + step (measured, oxlint 1.87, eslint-plugin-unicorn 77.0.0)

oxc/missing-throw.because: read-oxc-stand-ins: oxc with oxlint, sonarjs without. Both report new Error('failed') left as a statement, and leave one thrown or returned; sonarjs's reports new TypeError(…) too, which oxc's leaves (measured, oxlint 1.87, ESLint 10.12, eslint-plugin-sonarjs 4.2.2)
